name: Team Work
description: You have a team of N people. For a particular task, you can pick any non-empty subset of people. The cost of having x people for the task is x k . Output the sum of costs over all non-empty subsets of people.
input_specification: Only line of input contains two integers N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10 9 ) representing total number of people and k (1 ≤ k ≤ 5000) .
output_specification: Output the sum of costs for all non empty subsets modulo 10 9 + 7 .
approach_summary: Apply Knapsack and Basic Dynamic Programming paradigm under the Dynamic Programming (DP) framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
